verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street publishes a set of openly accessible resource guides relevant to founders, including O-1 for startup founders, F-1/J-1 to O-1 transitions, O-1 vs EB-1, reference letters, high remuneration and RFE handling. These cover parts of criteria breakdowns and process explanation. The evidence shows only short snippets, so how substantial the guides are is unproven, and the ebook 'download link' may be gated. missing for 10: real case examples, evidence of guide depth/substance, confirmation the ebook and all guides are ungated, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider publishes substantial free guides on startup visas — criteria breakdowns, process explainers, real examples — open to anyone, not gated lead bait

citations.quote: As a startup founder, you can indeed apply for an O-1 visa if you can demonstrate your extraordinary abilities and achievements in your field.
As a basic rule of thumb, each reference you submit should speak to each of the visa criteria that you meet.
Publishes a dedicated open guide to handling a USCIS Request for Evidence
Find benchmarks to prove your financial success.
